session_center_sync_note: NOT explicitly re-tested E2E in this iteration. Phase 2 session-center sync was tested in iteration_12. Code review: routes/offices.py::update_office does NOT touch db.active_sessions on PATCH. The 'next ping picks up new radius' promise relies on ping-time re-read of office doc. Line 199 of routes/mobile.py reads office['radius_meters'] fresh on create, but the active-session doc stores center.radius_m at session-create time — active sessions in memory are NOT re-synced when the office is patched. If Phase 2 promised session-center sync, VERIFY this behaviour with a live E2E (create session → patch office radius → next ping → assert center.radius_m updated). Deferred to main agent.
